assessments.reasoning: Bound to post35-ngrep-original-reference revision 1. The jpr5/ngrep project repository returned LICENSE at commit 351ac491358f89a7860bbbe9963cb4bc7d60000f with HTTP 200 and one retained range covering all 3393 bytes. The reported SHA-256 d46e593e048e0b9fc803561ed4c283f37a2d5447e4dcfa10cad29b394c2b8b9e matches the claimed representation. The opening copyright, grant, five restrictions, and disclaimer identify Ritter’s notice at the cited locator. The project file provides the documentary text.

Bound to five-project-notices-lifecycle-2026-11-28 revision 1. The decision in the software-commons/license-index repository at commit acce97c2c5dbbf6228c02f95a5f43b5d20c0801e supplies the editorial classification. Its row gives prospective entity key b9eac3b4df1840be87425d2b4d196c8d, the payload of claim subject e-b9eac3b4df1840be87425d2b4d196c8d, discovery identifier ngrep, display name ngrep License, kind license, edition ngrep-captured-reference, revision sha256:d46e593e048e0b9fc803561ed4c283f37a2d5447e4dcfa10cad29b394c2b8b9e, and lifecycle active. The decision explicitly limits the row to Jordan Ritter’s 2017 notice.

challenge.method: Inspected the complete retained ngrep LICENSE and Index decision. Checked the commit-pinned publisher and editorial routes and compared the publisher capture digest to the row. Tested whether the second notice could fall within the claimed identity by locating the end of Ritter’s disclaimer and the start of the tcpkill attribution.
challenge.results: Ritter’s 2017 notice ends with its own disclaimer. The ensuing tcpkill attribution introduces Dug Song’s 1999–2000 copyright, separate redistribution conditions, and separate disclaimer. The Index expressly scopes its active row to Ritter’s notice. The row digest matches the complete LICENSE capture that contains both notices.

limitations: The active classification concerns documentary lookup for Ritter’s notice in the exact capture. The full-file digest also covers the separate Dug Song notice.
Applicability to other works, legal equivalence, reuse, and installation require separate evidence.

The editor and publisher routes were checked using the returned commit-pinned URLs and complete retained texts. Byte integrity was evaluated using the acquisition-reported hashes and coverage. The supplied policy commit and bundle digest were taken as given.
reasoning: The project LICENSE establishes the cited Ritter notice and its boundaries. The Index decision assigns the same captured edition and digest to the claimed entity, display name, and kind, with an active lifecycle limited to that notice.
